The socks feature a prominent cable-knit or textured pattern on the upper leg portion and a striped pattern (white, purple, brown, green) on the heel and sole area. The toes are not visible as the feet are angled slightly inward/backward. The background is blurred, showing what appears to be indoor flooring and furniture legs.
